name: ShortlistSwipeDeck
job: Let visitors swipe through the owner's items (products, venues, portfolio pieces) keeping or skipping each, ending in a shortlist tray with a single enquire link
visitor_action: swipe or drag cards right to keep and left to skip; keep and skip buttons and arrow keys work too; open the tray to review
mobile: native swipe, buttons below for thumb reach, collapsible shortlist tray
motion: card follows finger with tilt, flies off with spring, next card scales up (reduced-motion: buttons only, card fades out)

checks.render: pass (no fix; 375 shot shows unloaded photos, a harness artifact seen on other image components too)

art_direction: Clay and cobalt: warm clay-pink cards on soft off-white, flat cobalt action buttons, soft low shadows (card gloss dropped per contemporary-polish rule)
